pages.text: This module adds inventory and item management features.

pages.title: Arrow Scrolling
pages.text: Sneaking with a bow and scrolling the mouse wheel cycles arrows.

pages.title: Auto Tool Restock
pages.text: Automatically replaces broken tools with new ones.

pages.title: Improved Crafting
pages.text: Shift + right-click transfers an item into the crafting grid.

pages.title: Chest Buttons
pages.text: Buttons added to organize items in chests.

pages.title: Chests in Boats
pages.text: Right-click a boat to place a chest inside it.

pages.title: Item Dropoff
pages.text: Click this button to deposit items into nearby chests.

pages.title: F Key Swap
pages.text: The F key now works inside the inventory.

pages.title: Favorite Items
pages.text: Alt + right-click to protect items from being deposited.

pages.title: Hotbar Swapper
pages.text: Press Z to open/close the expanded hotbar.

pages.title: Item Sharing
pages.text: Press Shift + T to showcase an item in chat.

pages.title: Quick Shulkers
pages.text: Put items into a shulker box directly in your inventory.

pages.title: Sorting Button

pages.title: Backpacks
pages.text: Can be bought from leatherworkers; opened on right-click.
